repositories.name: claude-mem
repositories.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repositories.readmeExcerpt: Persistent memory compression system built for Claude Code.

repositories.name: hallmark
repositories.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
repositories.readmeExcerpt: A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated.

repositories.name: t3code
repositories.readmeExcerpt: T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app (iOS, Android), web app and Electron-based desktop app.

repositories.name: skills
repositories.readmeExcerpt: This repository contains skills that demonstrate what's possible with Claude's skills system. These skills range from creative applications (art, music, design) to technical tasks (testing web apps, MCP server generation) to enterprise workflows (communications, branding, etc.).

repositories.name: DeepTutor
repositories.readmeExcerpt: DeepTutor is an agent-native learning workspace that connects tutoring, research, creation, and practice in one extensible system.

repositories.name: worktrunk
repositories.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
repositories.readmeExcerpt: Worktrunk's three core commands make worktrees as easy as branches. Plus, Worktrunk has a bunch of quality-of-life features to simplify working with many parallel changes, including hooks to automate local workflows & copy-on-write build caches.

repositories.name: OpenMausBot
repositories.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
repositories.readmeExcerpt: The open-source Grok Bot alternative: your own team of AI bots, in a chat app. Every bot in the sidebar is a real agent — Claude or Codex running locally under the hood — with its own personality, its own model, its own cloud computer, and its own connected apps. Talk to them like contacts. Watch them work.

repositories.name: superpowers
repositories.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repositories.readmeExcerpt: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.

repositories.name: impeccable
repositories.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
repositories.readmeExcerpt: Reload your coding tool, then run /impeccable init in your agent ($impeccable init on Codex). Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Replit Agent, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, Kiro, Trae, Rovo Dev, Qoder, Mistral Vibe, Pi, Hermes Agent, DeepSeek Harness, and Veto.

repositories.name: Hyprland
repositories.description: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks.
repositories.readmeExcerpt: Hyprland is a 100% independent, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks. It provides the latest Wayland features, is highly customizable, has all the eyecandy, the most powerful plugins, easy IPC, much more QoL stuff than other compositors and more...

repositories.name: skills
repositories.description: A collection of agent skills that help you build great interfaces.
repositories.readmeExcerpt: A collection of agent skills that cover UI, typography, colors, accessibility, layout, product writing and help you build a great interface.

repositories.name: OpenMontage
repositories.description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
repositories.readmeExcerpt: The first open-source, agentic video production system.

repositories.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
repositories.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
repositories.readmeExcerpt: Four principles in one file that directly address these issues.

repositories.name: ghostty
repositories.description: 👻 Ghostty is a fast, feature-rich, and cross-platform terminal emulator that uses platform-native UI and GPU acceleration.
repositories.readmeExcerpt: Ghostty is a terminal emulator that differentiates itself by being fast, feature-rich, and native. While there are many excellent terminal emulators available, they all force you to choose between speed, features, or native UIs. Ghostty provides all three.

repositories.name: taste-skill
repositories.description: Agent skills that give coding agents taste: art direction, reference images and a browser check instead of generic AI pages
repositories.readmeExcerpt: Taste Skill (tasteskill 2.5.0) is an Agent Skill that makes coding agents build professional company websites at the figma.com and x.ai level instead of assembling a generic landing page.

repositories.name: pr-agent
repositories.description: 🚀 PR Agent: The Original Open-Source PR Reviewer. This project is not the Qodo free tier.
repositories.readmeExcerpt: This repository contains the open-source PR Agent Project. It is not the Qodo offering for open-source projects. PR-Agent is an open-source, AI-powered code review agent and a community-maintained legacy project of Qodo.
